projects.title: Finance Tracker – MERN Stack
projects.bodyText:
- Developed a finance tracking web application using the MERN stack.
- Implemented secure authentication with JWT and bcrypt for user access control.
- Designed a user-friendly dashboard with Chart.js to visualize income and expenses.

projects.title: Heart Disease Detection using Machine Learning
projects.bodyText:
- Developed a machine learning model for heart disease detection using Logistic Regression.
- Performed data preprocessing, including handling missing values and encoding categorical variables.
- Conducted Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA) to understand data distributions and patterns.
- Split the dataset into training and testing sets for model evaluation.

projects.title: Secure Communication System using Blockchain and Cryptography
projects.bodyText:
- Developed a secure communication system with message encryption and decryption using cryptographic algorithms and unique random keys.
- Utilized Blockchain to create an immutable ledger for message verification and integrity.
- Deployed sender and receiver components separately for enhanced scalability and reliability.

projects.title: Library Management System
projects.bodyText:
- Designed and implemented a Library Management System in Java with MySQL for user management and book transactions.
- Created admin and user roles for managing book inventory and borrowing operations.
- Integrated user authentication and error handling for seamless database interactions.
